id: AMENDMENT_2_DRAFT gate-fix prompt candidate set v1 (gate-fix methodologist lens, 2026-10-02)
status: DRAFT input for idea-stage/PREREG_AMENDMENT_2.md; freeze (hash rendered prompts) BEFORE any new GPU run

invariants.backbone_for_selection: Qwen3-8B, fp16, chat template, enable_thinking=False, prefill-only, Yes/No read by token id (amendment C0 unchanged)
invariants.candidate_desc: "\nDescription: " + text[:200] if text else ""  (unchanged from prompting.build_prompt)
invariants.answer_suffix: Answer with only Yes or No.
forbidden_in_any_variant: item average rating, item popularity counts or any collaborative statistic (would inject a CF label proxy into the 'LLM channel')
user profile / user mean rating (UAUC-inert: constant within user)
few-shot demonstrations (adds an uncontrolled demo-selection degree of freedom; Kang et al. 2023 report <=0.014 AUC gain)
thinking on, verbalized confidence, rating-digit expected value (different channels, not a prompt fix)
invariants.V0_byte_identity_test: V0 rendering of the pilot ML-1M panel must reproduce report.json config.prompts_sha1 12e83c4fcca40db398ac58acbba2a7eb9c770524 for questions like,dislike,like_para

like_family.like: Would this user like the candidate item?
like_family.dislike: Would this user dislike the candidate item?
like_family.like_para: Is the candidate item a good match for this user's taste?
like_family.dislike_para: Would this user be disappointed by the candidate item?
like_family.next: Will this user purchase the candidate item next?

threshold_family.like: Will this user rate the candidate item 4 stars or higher (on a 1-5 scale)?
threshold_family.dislike: Will this user rate the candidate item 2 stars or lower (on a 1-5 scale)?
threshold_family.like_para: Will this user's star rating for the candidate item be 4 or 5?
threshold_family.dislike_para: Will this user's star rating for the candidate item be 1 or 2?
threshold_family.next: Will this user purchase the candidate item next?

system_messages.rated_movie: You are a movie recommender. You predict how a specific user will rate movies from that user's past ratings. Ratings range from 1 to 5 stars; 4-5 stars means the user liked the movie and 1-2 stars means the user disliked it.
system_messages.rated_product: You are a product recommender. You predict how a specific user will rate products from that user's past ratings. Ratings range from 1 to 5 stars; 4-5 stars means the user liked the product and 1-2 stars means the user disliked it.
system_messages.next_product: You are a product recommender. You predict a specific user's preferences from that user's purchase history.

history_line_formats.L_split: - {title}   (empty list -> '- (none)'; liked = rating > 3, disliked = rating <= 3, TALLRec rule)

V1.grounding: label-aligned star-threshold question (registered label: >=4 like, <=2 dislike); rating framing of Kang et al. 2023

next_item.note: no ratings -> renders identically to V0 (declared, not distinct on next-item panels)

V3.grounding: longer history (ReLLa WWW'24 Fig. 6: zero-shot AUC peaks near K=15 on ML-1M; 20 is inside the tested range)

V4.grounding: history item metadata, Kang et al. 2023 'Title, Genres, Rating' history format

V5.grounding: system role + explicit rating scale (Kang et al. 2023 'Ratings range from 1.0 to 5.0'); chat system slot

rated.hist: 10 of the last 50 pre-candidate events with highest cosine to the candidate (Qwen3-8B mean-pooled last-layer state of 'Title: {title}. {text[:200]}', PCA-512 fit on panel items), printed chronologically; ties -> more recent

next_item.note: falls back to the V0 next-item rendering (per-candidate histories defeat prefix caching; projected M2 cost would exceed E4)

V7.grounding: combined Kang-style: V1 + V3 + V4 + V5

dev_scoring_is_MIRROR_blind: rated dev panels: score ONLY question 'like' per variant; next-item dev: ONLY 'next' per distinct rendering. dislike, like_para, dislike_para, swap prior, no-history prior are NOT scored on dev for any variant.
